report.aggregation: Report all point predictions, plus an equal-weight mean over grid/outcome-day groups: first average paired absolute errors across eligible points within each group, then average groups. Compare analog and seasonal predictions on the identical point/variable subset. Report group and point counts separately, including missing outcomes and insufficient predictions. Shared outcomes are not independent replications; adjacent outcome days may also be correlated. No accuracy conclusion before outcomes arrive.

report.scope: Frozen forecast-input analogs evaluated against later NASA POWER/MERRA-2 regional reanalysis, not station measurements or address-level impacts. Equal weighting of grid/outcome-day groups avoids counting a shared outcome as independent repetitions. Adjacent days remain correlated. A small convenience cohort cannot establish general operational skill or calibrated probabilities.
